children: Nuburu plans to hold its annual stockholder meeting on December 29, 2026, with November 27 set as the voting record date.
Stockholders of record on November 27, 2026, will be entitled to notice of and vote at the annual meeting.
Rule 14a-8 proposals for inclusion in proxy materials must reach Nuburu by December 5, 2026.
December 5 is also the deadline for other meeting nominations or proposals under the bylaws and notices required under the universal proxy rules.
